description: Source code for Expense Claim doctype in ERPNext, including class definitions, methods for validation, accounting entries, and utility functions related to expense claims.

classes.name: InvalidExpenseApproverError
classes.description: Custom validation error for invalid expense approver.

classes.name: ExpenseApproverIdentityError
classes.description: Custom validation error for expense approver identity issues.

classes.name: ExpenseClaim
classes.description: Main class representing an expense claim, with methods for validation, accounting, and status management.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Initializes the expense claim on load, setting payment method from settings.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs various validation checks on the expense claim before submission.

methods.name: set_status
methods.description: Sets the status of the expense claim based on payment and approval status.

methods.name: on_update
methods.description: Shares document with the expense approver upon update.

methods.name: set_payable_account
methods.description: Sets default payable account if not specified.

methods.name: set_cost_center
methods.description: Sets default cost center if not specified.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Handles logic when expense claim is submitted, including validation, GL entries, and reimbursement updates.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Handles logic when expense claim is canceled, including reversing GL entries and reimbursement adjustments.

methods.name: update_claimed_amount_in_employee_advance
methods.description: Updates claimed amount in related employee advances.

methods.name: update_task_and_project
methods.description: Updates related task or project with expense claim info.

methods.name: make_gl_entries
methods.description: Creates general ledger entries for the expense claim.

methods.name: get_gl_entries
methods.description: Generates GL entries based on expense claim details.

methods.name: add_tax_gl_entries
methods.description: Adds tax-related GL entries.

methods.name: validate_account_details
methods.description: Validates expense account details and payment mode.

methods.name: calculate_total_amount
methods.description: Calculates total claimed and sanctioned amounts.

methods.name: calculate_taxes
methods.description: Calculates taxes and total payable amount.

methods.name: update_task
methods.description: Updates associated task with expense info.

methods.name: validate_advances
methods.description: Validates employee advances against claimed amounts.

methods.name: validate_sanctioned_amount
methods.description: Ensures sanctioned amounts do not exceed claimed amounts.

methods.name: set_expense_account
methods.description: Assigns default expense accounts based on expense type.

methods.name: update_reimbursed_amount
methods.description: Updates total reimbursed amount and status.

methods.name: make_bank_entry
methods.description: Creates a bank journal entry for expense claim payment.

methods.name: get_expense_claim_account_and_cost_center
methods.description: Retrieves expense claim account and cost center for given type and company.

methods.name: get_expense_claim_account
methods.description: Fetches default account for expense claim type.

methods.name: get_advances
methods.description: Retrieves employee advances based on filters.

methods.name: get_expense_claim
methods.description: Creates a new expense claim document with provided details.
